01: Only a few of them, against a giant army? They'll lose for sure!
03: That's what they thought too. Let me tell you about Dawud, peace be upon him.
04: King Talut led the believers out against Jalut and his army. Most of them were afraid: We have no power against them today.
05: But those who were certain said: How many a small company has overcome a large company, by permission of Allah. And Allah is with the patient.
06: And they prayed: Our Lord, pour upon us patience, plant firmly our feet, and give us victory.
07: So they defeated them, by permission of Allah. And Dawud, peace be upon him, killed Jalut.
08: And after that? What happened to Dawud, peace be upon him?
09: Allah gave him kingship and wisdom. And Allah made iron soft for him, to make full coats of mail.
10: And the mountains and the birds glorified Allah together with him, in the evening and after sunrise.
12: He was a king... and still he ate only from the work of his own hands.
13: He fasted every other day. The Prophet, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, said this is the most beloved fasting to Allah.
14: So the few won... and their hero became a king who still worked with his own hands!
15: Because Allah told the family of Dawud, peace be upon him: Work, in gratitude.
